game_title: Validation Fortress – Salt Flat Crossing Streak
game_concept: A rhythm puzzle set in Sand Dunes – Salt Flat Crossing, a blinding salt flat: the scarab scholar must handle vultures while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Validation Fortress: Write input checks that reject bad data so vultures can't sneak through.
theme: Sand Dunes – Salt Flat Crossing: a blinding salt flat
core_gameplay_loop: In Salt Flat Crossing, repeat each round: Write input checks that reject bad data so vultures can't sneak through. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the fortress value and advance.
player_objective: Chain 14 consecutive correct decisions about fortress to power up the scarab scholar and open the temple door.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 9 – Debugging & Combined Skills | Level 10 (extended tier): Validation Fortress
assets_style: sun-baked pixel-art desert: golden dunes, tall cacti, a bright blue oasis, warm orange shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Validation Fortress' (Week 9 slot 14), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Salt Flat Crossing'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Sand Dunes
region.mood: desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how fortress changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against vultures in Salt Flat Crossing.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 14.
